title: The Docket Watch: 10 Bay Area Corruption Cases Still Moving Through Court
subtitle: A season-closing roundup of unresolved cases
description: A survey of ten Bay Area public-corruption cases that are indicted, charged, or awaiting sentencing but not yet resolved. Unlike Episodes 1-14, none of these cases get the show's usual 'how they got away with it' framing, because none of them have a final outcome yet.

producerNotes: EDITORIAL RATIONALE: 10 of the 24 case files originally compiled for this project describe cases that are indicted, under investigation, or awaiting sentencing rather than resolved. The season's 'how they got away with it' premise does not apply to a case with no final outcome, and narrating one as though it fit that premise would misstate its status. This episode is the honest home for that material: presumption-of-innocence language throughout, explicit per-case status, and no sentencing narrative implied. Re-verify every status line before air - these are the case files most likely to have moved.
